title: Compare Two C Strings
hints: `a == b` asks whether the two pointers hold the same address. You need to compare the chars: walk both pointers forward together, looking at `*a` and `*b` at each step.

At each position, in this order: if `*a != *b` the strings differ, return `false`. Otherwise the chars are equal, so if `*a == '\0'` both strings just ended together, return `true`. Otherwise `++a; ++b;`. For `starts_with`, loop while `*prefix != '\0'` and return `false` on the first mismatch; the terminator of a too-short `s` is a mismatch like any other.
